criteria.criterion: docs/decisions.md has a new entry naming the 1800 to 3000 change, the evidence (the named failed jobs), the alternatives (splitting jobs, a faster suite, keeping work on timeout, each marked queued), and how to reverse it.
criteria.evidence: Read in the diff: D124 comes after D123, the last existing entry (grep of '## D12'). It names the change from 1800 to 3000, the five job ids, and says the sixth is not named. It labels the 5 to 10 minute builds as reported, not measured. Alternatives (a), (b) and (c) are each marked 'queued, not built here'. 'Reversal cost' gives the steps (set the value back to 1800, run cargo test --locked) and a proposed signal, labeled as not measured.

criteria.criterion: CHANGELOG.md has an entry under [Unreleased] describing the producer deadline raise from 1800 to 3000 seconds and why.
criteria.evidence: The new bullet is at CHANGELOG.md line 241, under '### Changed'. That is inside '## [Unreleased]', which runs from line 8 to the next release heading, '## [0.1.0]' at line 1542. It states the raise from 1800 to 3000 s and why (six lost runs, 5 to 10 minute builds as reported), and points to D124.

criteria.criterion: Run `cargo test`: the repository config test that parses athena.toml passes with producer_timeout_s = 3000, and the whole suite passes; `cargo clippy` is clean.
criteria.evidence: I ran the two targeted commands: config::tests::repository_config_parses_and_validates passed, and the 3 repo_config tests passed, including athena_toml_parses_with_this_crates_schema. findings.evidence: A grep of docs/system-facts.md finds no producer timeout or 1800 value, so nothing there states the old deadline. The planned files listed only the three that changed.

summary: The change does what the request asks. In athena.toml, producer_timeout_s goes from 1800 to 3000 and no other budget value changes. The new decision entry, D124 in docs/decisions.md, records the five named failed jobs and says the sixth is unnamed. It labels the 5 to 10 minute build times as reported, not measured, and marks each of the three alternatives as queued. It also gives the steps to reverse the change and a proposed signal for when to do so. CHANGELOG.md has a matching bullet under [Unreleased]. I ran the repository config parse tests and they pass with the new value. The full suite and clippy are covered by Athena's recorded passing checks on this tree.
